description: For financial advisors (requires a MySSAgent advisor account — sign in with your myssagent.com advisor account when prompted). Lists your client roster with each client's id, status, and whether an analysis is on file. Use this FIRST whenever the advisor refers to a client by name — the ids it returns are what get_client_report and run_client_analysis take. Read-only; nothing is changed.

search.description: Optional. Case-insensitive substring match on the client's name.

name: list_clients
title: List your MySSAgent clients
